lessons.observation: A noncircular candidate process can still leave the embedded owner receipt problem unsolved if the receipt tries to name the final ZIP.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: Detached final identity discipline worked; no V14 embedded owner receipt/payload inventory existed.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: The outer ZIP does not exist until after packaging, so its identity cannot be safely embedded.
lessons.test_or_evidence_that_revealed_it: V14 release identity and owner receipt standard.
lessons.product_change_made: Added a truthful embedded owner receipt and unified owner live-operations view.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Added separate payload inventory and final-delivery identity boundary validation.
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Prefer evidence architecture that can survive immutable packaging without self-reference.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Fresh extraction must verify payload inventory and receipt while recomputing outer ZIP identity independently.

lessons.observation: Many individually truthful records still impose owner burden when external states are not normalized into one view.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: Specialized controls worked; cross-service status and the next owner action were fragmented.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: Each subsystem evolved its own state representation.
lessons.test_or_evidence_that_revealed_it: Audit of AI, provider, deployment, domain, email, database, and billing owner records.
lessons.product_change_made: Added one unified evidence-state register and owner endpoint.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Added strict allowed states and unsupported VERIFIED_LIVE rejection.
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Select future integrations that reduce owner effort while preserving evidence boundaries.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Recovery must restore exact state vocabulary and never promote a dependency from source code alone.

unresolved_learning_questions: Which exact GitHub repository and Render service are canonical?
Which live evidence adapters can be connected without exposing secrets or sensitive content?
next_version_learning_priorities: Dark deployment and controlled smoke evidence
